Hi! Welcome! I am İsmail, an ecologist turned data scientist. I spent years building models to predict where forest fires spark, first during my PhD at ETH Zurich, then as a postdoc at the Technical University of Munich. Somewhere along the way, the data caught fire^1^ more than the forests did, so I am now kindling^2^ a new career in data science.

::: {style="text-align: right; font-size: 0.75em; color: grey;"}
^1^ Fire pun #1.\
^2^ Fire pun #2. 
:::
